entries.description:
Entries to ingest. Each entry is one of: a site (full subtree), a
drive (full drive contents), a drive_by_id (a drive identified
only by its drive_id), a directory, or a single file.

SharepointIngestionEntry.description:
A single SharePoint entry to ingest. entry_type determines which other
fields are required:
- "site": object_id is required.
- "drive": drive_id is required.
- "drive_by_id": drive_id is required. Use this for drives only reachable by direct drive_id (OneDrive personal, M365 group drives, drives in non-discoverable sites).
- "directory": drive_id and object_id are required.
- "file": drive_id and object_id are required.

name.description: Display name of the entry. Optional — used in logs.

web_url.description: Web URL of the entry. Optional — derived from drive_id/object_id when omitted.

SharepointOnlineCredentials.description:
Credentials for SharePoint Online. Provide either the app-auth triple
(tenant_name + client_id + client_secret) or the OAuth-user pair
(user_id + optional connector_id). The auth_type field must match.

auth_type.description: "app" for application credentials, "user" for delegated OAuth.

client_id.description: Azure AD application client ID (app auth only).

client_secret.description: Azure AD application client secret (app auth only).

user_id.description: User ID owning the OAuth token (user auth only).

connector_id.description: Optional connector ID when the user has more than one linked SharePoint connector.

admin_enumerate_drives.description:
App auth only. When true, discovery additionally enumerates every
drive in the tenant via /drives. Requires Files.Read.All /
Sites.Read.All on the application.
